title: Fever Observational Study
brief_summary: To inform the feasibility of conducting a study to test different temperature thresholds at which clinicians deliver interventions to reduce fever (i.e. antipyretic interventions) in critically ill children with fever due to infection.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

unplanned PICU admission referral requiring PICU admission to a participating unit
study_population: All unplanned admissions to a PICU
